headline: Waste Connections: Better Margins, But Volume Trend Is Still Weak
summary: Waste Connections (WCN:CA) Q2 2026 shows strong pricing, margins and raised guidance, but volumes keep falling. See hold view, valuation (~15x EBITDA).
